advancements.orespawn_delight.chef_de_ch: Bake a Yellowcake and wash down some Irradiated Jerky. A balanced diet of isotopes.
Assemble a Dino Dog Grande. It's not for you.
Box up a real heart with chocolate, strawberries and cherries. Romance is not dead — it's an ingredient.

Eat every absurd dish on the menu and get your hands on every absurd creation — the steak, the drink, the Hammy, five rock candies, the chili, the hotpot, the ramen, the dango, the wings, the gummies, the floss, the shooter, the macaron, the roast, and all the things you probably shouldn't have made.
orespawn_delight.jei.info.ray_seared_ste: Ray-Seared Steak has no recipe and no furnace was ever consulted. Shoot a dropped piece of Raw Beef — or an entire unlucky cow — with the Ray Gun, and the laser does the cooking. Still faintly humming.
